requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be, in height, above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: Above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

requirements.text: If the optional S1 or S2 category stop lamps are installed, the optional stop lamps shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be positioned, in length, at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, except that for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle. However, for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: The S3 or S4 category stop lamp devices shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 10° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 categories devices: 10° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle;

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) Where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The S3 or S4 category stop lamp devices shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 categories devices: 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Orientation Towards the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.quote: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp (devices of R or R1 or R2 categories) shall be mandatory.
requirements.quote: Presence Devices of R or R1 or R2 categories: Mandatory

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be two in number, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: Number Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be so positioned in width that the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane is not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, except that this condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle. This condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.

requirements.text: For all categories of vehicles other than M1 and N1, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear position lamps in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: be not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground, except that the maximum may be 2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed.
requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

requirements.text: If the optional rear position lamps are installed, the optional rear position lamps shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In length: The rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° inwards and 80° outwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°, and (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) Where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: Where, for M1 and N1 category vehicles, the alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. is applied at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative and a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° outwards to 45° inwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: Where, for M1 and N1 category vehicles, the alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. is applied at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative and a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11., except that if a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.quote: Electrical connections In accordance with paragraph 5.11. However, if a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a closed-circuit tell-tale, except that this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.quote: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp tell-tale shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.
requirements.quote: It shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.

requirements.text: Where required by the component Regulation, the rear position lamp shall have a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.quote: However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be present on motor vehicles.
requirements.quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two in number, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.quote: Number Two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.

requirements.text: Where additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) are fitted, the additional retro-reflecting devices and materials shall not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.quote: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below), are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.

requirements.text: The point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where the vehicle is of a category other than M1 and N1, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: be not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm above the ground, except that the maximum is not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), and 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively.
requirements.quote: In height: Above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a geometric visibility horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 30° inwards and outwards.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal, except that where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 10° above and below horizontal. However, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Rearwards.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.

requirements.text: All markings on the device shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the retro-reflective device shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the retro-reflective device shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.quote: The four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.

requirements.text: The sequential number of the retro-reflective device shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.quote: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: Where the approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark of the retro-reflective device shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I.
requirements.quote: The Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown below: Figure I Unique Identifier (UI)

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflective device is a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the retro-reflective device shall bear the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: in case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflective device is retro-reflective marking material of Class C, D, E or F whose retro-reflective system is not omni-rotational, the retro-reflective marking material shall bear an orientation mark "TOP".
requirements.quote: in case of retro-reflective marking material of Class C, D, E or F an orientation mark "TOP" on any marking material whose retro-reflective system is not omni-rotational.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflective device is a retro-reflective marking plate of Class 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 whose retro-reflective system is not omni-rotational, the retro-reflective marking plate shall bear the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the part of the plate which is intended to be the highest part of the plate when mounted on the vehicle.
requirements.quote: in case of retro-reflective marking plates of Class 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5, on the plates whose retro-reflective system is not omni-rotational, the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the part of the plates which is intended to be the highest part of the plate when mounted on the vehicle.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retro-reflective device.
requirements.quote: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
requirements.quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps in retro-reflective devices, the size of the components of the single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall meet the requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval.
requirements.quote: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible, the retro-reflective device shall meet the requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed.
requirements.quote: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
requirements.quote: In addition, they must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.

requirements.text: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.quote: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
requirements.quote: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective devices shall not be rough.
requirements.quote: The surface shall therefore not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.

requirements.text: Any protuberances the outer surface of the retro-reflective devices may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.quote: The surface shall therefore not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.

requirements.text: When in normal use, the retro-reflectors shall provide no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors.
requirements.quote: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, the retro-reflecting optical unit and filter shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflectors may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, which must be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.

requirements.text: The retro-reflecting optical units and filters of the retro-reflector shall not be coloured by means of paint or varnish.
requirements.quote: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.

requirements.text: When tested for colour, the retro-reflective device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.
requirements.quote: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflective device is white, red or amber, the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity of the retro-reflective device shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., the retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.quote: (a) The dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5; and

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., the retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.quote: (b) The photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.; and

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., the retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
requirements.quote: (c) The physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.

requirements.text: The applicant shall submit ten samples of the retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB for approval which shall be tested in the chronological order as indicated in paragraph 5.1.7.
requirements.quote: The applicant shall submit ten samples for approval which shall be tested in the chronological order as indicated in paragraph 5.1.7.

requirements.text: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples of the retro-reflector shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.quote: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.

requirements.text: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.quote: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.

requirements.text: The two retro-reflector samples giving the minimum and maximum values shall be kept by the laboratories for any further checks which may be found necessary.
requirements.quote: These two samples shall be kept by the laboratories for any further checks which may be found necessary.

requirements.text: The other eight retro-reflector samples shall be divided into four groups of two.
requirements.quote: The other eight samples shall be divided into four groups of two:

requirements.text: The two retro-reflector samples of the first group shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
requirements.quote: First group: The two samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).

requirements.text: The two retro-reflector samples of the second group shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
requirements.quote: Second group: The two samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.

requirements.text: The two retro-reflector samples of the third group shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
requirements.quote: Third group: The two samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.

requirements.text: The two retro-reflector samples of the fourth group shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
requirements.quote: Fourth group: The two samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.quote: A colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.quote: A RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.

requirements.text: The RI verification of the retro-reflectors shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.quote: The verification shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.

requirements.text: When applying for approval, the applicant shall specify one or more or a range of axis of reference of the retro-reflector, corresponding to the illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° in the table of coefficients of luminous intensity RI.
requirements.quote: When applying for approval, the applicant shall specify one or more or a range of axis of reference, corresponding to the illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° in the table of coefficients of luminous intensity RI.

requirements.text: Where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements of the retro-reflector shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In the case where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface of the retro-reflector defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered.
requirements.quote: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered

requirements.text: The illuminating surface of the retro-reflector shall be limited to 100 cm2, except that the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not necessarily attain this area.
requirements.quote: the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2 though the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not necessarily attain this area.

requirements.text: The manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area of the retro-reflector to be used.
requirements.quote: The manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area to be used.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA and Class IB shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
requirements.quote: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors must be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall not have RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the following lines: (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.quote: RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the following lines: (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).

requirements.text: Where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values of the retro-reflector shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.quote: However, in the case where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB, is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.

requirements.text: The testing of the colour for the retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
requirements.quote: The testing of the colour for retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux must be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.

requirements.text: Where the Type Approval Authorities authorize laboratories to omit certain unnecessary tests depending on the nature of the materials of the retro-reflector and its optical units, such omission shall be mentioned under "Remarks" on the form notifying approval, and such omission shall only be applicable to tests described in Part 3 of Annex 4, in Parts 4, 5 and 6 of Annex 6.
requirements.quote: the Type Approval Authorities may authorize laboratories to omit certain unnecessary tests, subject to the express reservation that such omission must be mentioned under "Remarks" on the form notifying approval. This is only applicable to tests described in Part 3 of Annex 4, in Parts 4, 5 and 6 of Annex 6.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector samples shall be tested in the chronological order of tests specified in Table 4 (Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB) or Table 5 (Class IVA), as applicable.
requirements.quote: Chronological order of tests Table 4 Chronological order of tests (Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB)

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', where the retro-reflector is not marked "TOP", the retro-reflector shall be rotated about its axis of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: When the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflector shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε, except that if the specified values are not attained, the retro-reflector may be rotated about its axis of reference ±5° from that position.
requirements.quote: When the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε. If the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference ±5° from that position.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', where the retro-reflector is marked "TOP", the retro-reflector shall be rotated about its axis ±5°.
requirements.quote: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°.

requirements.text: The RI of the retro-reflector marked "TOP" shall not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the retro-reflector during this rotation.
requirements.quote: The RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.

requirements.text: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI of the retro-reflector exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
requirements.quote: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflector is of Class IA or IB, the shape of the illuminating surfaces of the retro-reflector shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.quote: The shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflector has a moulded plastics reflector, the retro-reflector shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 ºC.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflector and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible.
requirements.quote: After this test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.

requirements.text: For the water penetration test, the retro-reflector, whether part of a lamp or not, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not, or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.

requirements.text: The water penetration test of the retro-reflector shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflector through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.quote: This test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.quote: These sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.

requirements.text: After the water penetration test, no water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit of the retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflector shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.quote: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, in the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.quote: In the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.

requirements.text: Where requested by the manufacturer as an alternative, the retro-reflective device of Class IB or IIIB shall be subjected to the following tests (moisture and dust test).
requirements.quote: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the following tests (moisture and dust test) shall be applied.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device sample, mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded, shall be subjected to a water spray as specified in the water spray test procedure.
requirements.quote: Water spray test procedure A sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded shall be subjected to a water spray as follows:

requirements.text: When the retro-reflector is subjected to the water spray test and is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
requirements.quote: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.

requirements.text: The water spray test of the retro-reflective device shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
requirements.quote: Test duration The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, the interior of the retro-reflective device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.
requirements.quote: Upon completion of the drain period. The interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, the retro-reflective device shall have no standing pool of water formed, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.quote: No standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
requirements.quote: The RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: Measured sample evaluation Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.

requirements.text: The resistance of the front surface of the retro-reflective device to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked, in accordance with ISO Standard 9227:2017.
requirements.quote: The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the retro-reflective device sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.quote: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.

requirements.text: The resistance to fuels test of the retro-reflective device shall apply a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol.
requirements.quote: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for either:

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol.
requirements.quote: (a) The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.

requirements.text: After about five minutes following wiping with the test mixture, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually.
requirements.quote: (b) After about five minutes, the surface shall be inspected visually.

requirements.text: After wiping with the test mixture, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.quote: It must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.

requirements.text: In the test procedure for resistance to lubricating oils, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
requirements.quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.

requirements.text: After about 5 minutes, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned.
requirements.quote: After about 5 minutes, the surface shall be cleaned.

requirements.text: After cleaning, the RI of the retro-reflective device shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The RI shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall: (a) Specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128, granted to this ESA; or (b) Provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority, stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.
requirements.quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall: (a) Specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128, granted to this ESA; or (b) Provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority, stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.

requirements.text: If an ESA is (part of) a light source and the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. above is missing, approval of this ESA according to Regulation No. 10 shall not be granted.
requirements.quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source and if the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. above is missing, approval of this ESA according to Regulation No. 10 shall not be granted.

requirements.text: An approval number shall be assigned to each vehicle or ESA type approved in accordance with Schedule 4 of the 1958 Agreement (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3).
requirements.quote: An approval number shall be assigned to each vehicle or ESA type approved in accordance with Schedule 4 of the 1958 Agreement (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3).

requirements.text: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
requirements.quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation. No marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.

requirements.text: An international approval mark shall be affixed, in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form, on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.quote: An international approval mark shall be affixed, in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form, on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1. above.
requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1. above.

requirements.text: The vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.

requirements.text: Before testing, the Technical Service shall prepare a test plan in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s), monitored function(s), pass/fail criterion(criteria) and intended emissions.
requirements.quote: Before testing, the Technical Service shall prepare a test plan in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s), monitored function(s), pass/fail criterion(criteria) and intended emissions.

requirements.text: Depending on the intended operating conditions of the propulsion system, the test plan shall define the minimum number of steady state operating conditions of the vehicle, selectable by the driver or by the control system.
requirements.quote: Depending on the intended operating conditions of the propulsion system, the test plan shall define the minimum number of steady state operating conditions of the vehicle, selectable by the driver or by the control system.

requirements.text: The test conditions shall consider multiple propulsion system operating strategies which can be activated permanently by the driver or the vehicle control system.
requirements.quote: The test conditions shall consider multiple propulsion system operating strategies which can be activated permanently by the driver or the vehicle control system and shall be based on documentation provided in Annexes 2A and 2B (e.g. risk analysis).

requirements.text: The test conditions shall be based on documentation provided in Annexes 2A and 2B (e.g. risk analysis).
requirements.quote: The test conditions shall consider multiple propulsion system operating strategies which can be activated permanently by the driver or the vehicle control system and shall be based on documentation provided in Annexes 2A and 2B (e.g. risk analysis).

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the rear lamp ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband type approval limits for the rear lamp ESA shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation, and 63 dB microvolts/m constant in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation. In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.text: On the rear lamp ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the rear lamp ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
requirements.quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband type approval limits for the rear lamp ESA shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7, and 53 dB microvolts/m constant in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7. In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.text: On the rear lamp ESA representative of its type, the measured narrowband value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances on 12/24 V supply lines of the rear lamp ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.quote: The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.

requirements.text: The rear lamp ESA shall not exceed the maximum allowed pulse amplitude of Table 1: positive +75 V and negative -100 V for vehicles with 12 V systems, and positive +150 V and negative -450 V for vehicles with 24 V systems.
requirements.quote: Table 1 Maximum allowed pulse amplitude Maximum allowed pulse amplitude for Polarity of pulse amplitude Vehicles with 12 V systems Vehicles with 24 V systems Positive +75 V +150 V Negative -100 V -450 V

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the rear lamp ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.quote: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the rear lamp ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9.
requirements.quote: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9:

requirements.text: The rear lamp ESA shall be tested at the test severity given in Table 2a in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.

requirements.text: The rear lamp ESA shall be tested at not less than the minimum test level given in Table 2b over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: Test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.

requirements.text: During the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, the rear lamp ESA representative of its type shall exhibit no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
requirements.quote: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".

requirements.text: The immunity of the rear lamp ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.quote: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp ESA could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines which are started with a 12V/24V starter motor, the rear lamp ESA starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.quote: Starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.

requirements.text: The rear lamp ESA shall meet the Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as given in Table 3b.
requirements.quote: Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, the rear lamp ESA shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2. and with Annexes 5 and 8.
requirements.quote: Where a vehicle or electrical/electronic system or ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2. and with Annexes 5 and 8.

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp ESA has no immunity related functions, the rear lamp ESA shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8. and with Annex 9 to this Regulation without testing for immunity to radiated disturbances.
requirements.quote: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8. and with Annex 9 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp ESA is not switched, contains no switches or does not include inductive load, the rear lamp ESA shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7. without testing for transient conducted emission.
requirements.quote: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.

requirements.text: During the broadband emission test, the rear lamp ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp ESA is involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the rear lamp ESA shall be in charging mode during the test.
requirements.quote: ESAs involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" shall be in charging mode.

requirements.text: The state of charge (SOC) of the traction battery shall be kept between 20 per cent and 80 per cent of the maximum SOC during the whole frequency range measurement of the rear lamp ESA.
requirements.quote: The state of charge (SOC) of the traction battery shall be kept between 20 per cent and 80 per cent of the maximum SOC during the whole frequency range measurement (this may lead to split the measurement in different sub-bands with the need to discharge the vehicle's traction battery before starting the next sub-bands).

requirements.text: If the test is not performed with a REESS, the rear lamp ESA should be tested at rated current.
requirements.quote: If the test is not performed with a REESS the ESA should be tested at rated current.

requirements.text: If the current consumption of the rear lamp ESA can be adjusted, the current shall be set to at least 80 per cent of its maximum rated charging/input current value for AC charging.
requirements.quote: If the current consumption can be adjusted, then the current shall be set to at least 80 per cent of its maximum rated charging/input current value for AC charging.

requirements.text: If the current consumption of the rear lamp ESA can be adjusted, the current shall be set to at least 20 per cent of its nominal value or to a minimum of 16 A (if the 20 per cent of its nominal value cannot be achieved in the test facility) for DC charging, except that another value may be agreed with the type approval authorities.
requirements.quote: If the current consumption can be adjusted, then the current shall be set to at least 20 per cent of its nominal value or to a minimum of 16 A (if the 20 per cent of its nominal value cannot be achieved in the test facility) for DC charging unless another value is agreed with the type approval authorities.

requirements.text: The rear lamp ESA shall meet the radiated broadband emission limits throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).

requirements.text: If peak detectors are used for the radiated broadband emission measurement of the rear lamp ESA, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
requirements.quote: If peak detectors are used a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.

requirements.text: During the radiated narrowband emission tests, the rear lamp ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.

requirements.text: The rear lamp ESA shall meet the radiated narrowband emission limits throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).

requirements.text: The rear lamp ESA shall comply with the immunity requirements of any combination of the test methods (a) Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2, (b) TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3, (c) Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4, (d) Stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5, (e) Reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11, at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that the results cover the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex.
requirements.quote: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered

requirements.text: The frequency range and general test conditions for the immunity testing of the rear lamp ESA shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.quote: (Frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1).

requirements.text: During immunity tests, the rear lamp ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.

requirements.text: The immunity measurements of the rear lamp ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the immunity test signal modulation for the rear lamp ESA shall be: (a) AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range; (b) PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range; and (c) PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
requirements.quote: The test signal modulation shall be: (a) AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range; (b) PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range; and (c) PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges. If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.

requirements.text: The frequency step size and dwell time for the immunity testing of the rear lamp ESA shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.quote: Frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The rear lamp ESA shall be immune to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply.
requirements.quote: This test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply

requirements.text: The rear lamp ESA shall limit conducted transients to the vehicle power supply.
requirements.quote: and limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.

requirements.text: The rear lamp ESA shall be tested with the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.quote: Apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.

requirements.text: The rear lamp ESA shall be tested with the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to the starting profile.
requirements.quote: Apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines. ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by the rear lamp ESA on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as on other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.quote: Measurement according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.

profile.product: Rear lamp (combined rear lighting and signalling module with rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, outer lens and retro-reflector in a single housing)
functions: Rear position signalling (presence/visibility) - rear position lamp, 4 to 17 cd on axis
Braking indication - stop lamp, 60 to 185 cd on axis
Reversing illumination - reversing lamp, visible to 45° outboard
Passive conspicuity - retro-reflector, reflectivity at 5° angle of incidence
Light transmission and colour definition - outer lens, red within the chromaticity limits
Sealing against water ingress - no water ingress after the spray test
materials: Reflector surface: PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating
Light source: LED modules on PCB
Fasteners / clips: PA, POM, or steel
